tasks.task: Before changing the existing subscription item's price, preview the next upcoming invoice for exactly that proposed change, using the specified proration timestamp. Require amount due no more than USD 1,000. This is a preview check, not a guarantee of the final charge. After execution, confirm that invoice in_goal is paid, in USD, amount due at most USD 1,000, and belongs to sub_goal and cus_goal. Do not change anything in this experiment.

Using only an invoice preview, guarantee before updating sub_goal that the actual future charge will never exceed USD 1,000, including any currency conversion changes. A current estimate alone is insufficient. Determine whether this can be monitored with certainty; do not perform the change.

Monitor GitHub's recorded deployment state for deployment 1001 in cli/cli. Complete only if the deployment's recorded SHA is the specified SHA, environment is production, and its most recent deployment status is success. An older success followed by failure must not count. This requirement is about GitHub's recorded state, not independently measured server health.

Use only GitHub's deployment APIs to prove that production servers are currently serving the requested artifact with less than 1 percent errors. A deployment success status reported by an integration is not sufficient evidence of actual server health.

Watch the exact public GitHub Actions run in the context. Complete only when its latest attempt has status completed and conclusion success, its run ID matches, and its head SHA is the specified SHA. An in-progress attempt or completed failure does not count.

Monitor whether the exact message timestamp still exists in the specified private conversation, and detect deletion within 30 seconds using polling through Slack's standard Web API. Our commercially distributed app was created in June 2026 and is not approved for the Slack Marketplace. Identify any restriction that makes this requested monitoring interval infeasible. Message existence is sufficient; do not infer that anyone read it.

Using Slack's standard Web API, confirm that every human member of this private channel has read this exact message. Successful posting, existence in history, reactions, and the calling user's last-read marker do not establish that everyone read it. If this is not observable, say so.

After deleting customer cus_goal, prove that all personal data for that customer has been erased from all historical invoices, charges, and backups. A deleted-customer tombstone alone is insufficient. Use only Stripe's standard API documentation and identify gaps; do not delete anything.
